An '''animal trainer''' was an individual who trained [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures. [[Dams Denna/Legends|Dams Denna]], a resident of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], was an animal trainer. '''"Fingers"''' was the nick-name attributed to a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] animal herder. She specialized in training [[Borgle bat]]s for arena pit-fighting competition. She hunted the dangerous creatures in their native jungle environment on the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. On one occasion, a Borgle bat bit off two of the fingers on her right hand, earning the Zabrak the uncomplimentary nickname, ''Fingers''.
